purpose: Bring up services, apply schema migrations and expose the control panel.
notes: Validate Compose healthchecks, least privilege, safe shutdown, database readiness and idempotent boot. No root-level /dev/shm remount as a generic startup step.

purpose: Catalog internal task roles, capabilities, prompt versions and workload limits.
notes: Agent Fleet / Role Lab is interactive. Persist roles with schemas and version IDs; do not turn templates into fictitious external platform accounts.

purpose: Receive tasks, select a role, route execution and retain traceable results.
notes: Requires authenticated task API, schema validation, bounded concurrency, trace IDs and permission checks.

purpose: Generate three candidate plans and evaluate evidence, safety, cost and task fit.
notes: The A/B/C panel is visible, but scores are static. Backend needs parallel responses, JSON validation, independent judging and safe fallback rules.

purpose: Compare responses, check consistency and reject invalid or incomplete output.
notes: Add evidence checks, deterministic validators, confidence labels, request budgets and audit trail before output can trigger a task.

purpose: Probe configured inference routes and control prioritized fallback.
notes: Probe configured model endpoints server-side; model latency, errors, rate limits and budget are real metrics only after connection.

purpose: Remove GPS/device metadata from assets before approved publication.
notes: Implement privacy-preserving EXIF scrub with format validation, temporary-file cleanup and verification. Do not erase source attribution or rights evidence.

purpose: Create original age-aware story drafts from an editorial brief.
notes: Story Studio creates a local template draft. Real generation requires a provider, age/content validation, revision history and review before release.

purpose: Turn original scripts into illustration prompts, scenes, narration and rendered video.
notes: Need image/TTS/video provider adapters, FFmpeg worker, artifact storage and render verification. Inspiration may guide themes, not copy another creator’s expression.

purpose: Turn approved ideas into a reusable content pipeline and editorial queue.
notes: Define content briefs, lifecycle stages, duplicate checks, outcomes and manual review.

purpose: Editorial planning, writing assignments, revisions and approval workflows.
notes: Share a durable content model with role ownership, version history, sources and sign-off.

purpose: Plan community updates and schedule authorized responses.
notes: Use official platform APIs, rate limits, moderation and human approval; no synthetic engagement or account farms.

purpose: Adapt reviewed assets for supported social channels and keep a publication ledger.
notes: Official adapters, platform-specific payload validation, consent, retry/idempotency and explicit publish approval required.

files: WordPress REST draft references; Gutenberg linker
purpose: Convert approved story/media packages into WordPress drafts.
notes: The current button simulates a queue only. Add a server-side draft connector with a dedicated account and duplicate-post protection.

purpose: Dispatch render/sync work asynchronously and receive verified completion callbacks.
notes: Add HMAC, timestamp freshness, idempotency, payload allowlist, job TTL, result checks and an explicit opt-in remote compute policy.

purpose: Cluster errors, propose fixes, retry transient failures and quarantine bad routes.
notes: Logs and fixes are sample entries. Auto-heal only bounded retries/circuit breakers; code/schema patches require tests, branch review and rollback.

purpose: Summarize jobs, incidents, sync state and review items on a schedule.
notes: Use a real scheduler, time-zone-aware timestamps, delivery status and persisted report history.

purpose: Collect repository metadata and source notes for grounded research.
notes: GitHub is a configured source link only. NotebookLM has no verified automated connector here; use supported/manual workflows and cite source revision IDs.

purpose: Normalize public tool/API links, categorize records and detect duplicates.
notes: Validate URLs, schemas, licenses and source provenance; never execute scripts just because a catalog listed them.

purpose: Register tool connectors and validate their manifests/permissions.
notes: Implement explicit tool grants, schema-bound arguments, timeouts, sandboxing, audit logs and connector disable switches.

purpose: Monitor approved release notes, changelogs and security advisories.
notes: Use curated RSS/API sources, publish dates, links and human-reviewable summaries. Do not auto-mutate browser stealth or access-control evasion logic.

purpose: Cache local state and support bounded offline work.
notes: Define cache invalidation, TTL, conflict rules and encryption needs; volatile RAM is not durable storage.

purpose: Replicate checkpoints and approved records across configured nodes.
notes: Requires database schema, idempotent batches, conflict resolution, checksums and restore drills. No DB is connected in preview.

purpose: Schedule snapshots and recover from a verified known-good state.
notes: Do not trust SQL snippets as applied migrations. Backups need retention, restricted access, checksum and an actual restore test.

purpose: Track service heartbeats and detect stale workers.
notes: Use a real health endpoint and last-seen timestamp, plus missed-heartbeat thresholds and alert deduplication.

purpose: Assign authorized tasks by available CPU/GPU/memory capability.
notes: Require opt-in agents, actual metrics, resource quotas and load shedding; no hardware values are live in this UI.

purpose: Route jobs to explicitly enrolled nodes on a trusted network.
notes: Mutual authentication, node allowlisting, health checks, job budgets and outbound firewall rules are required.

purpose: Connect approved cloud resources and read available capacity/quotas.
notes: Use provider IAM roles, budget alerts and policy-compliant workloads. Cloud credits are not permission for unrelated compute/mining.

purpose: Run risky imports/tests in isolated, resource-limited environments.
notes: Containers need read-only mounts, no ambient credentials, network restrictions, process limits and destruction after task completion.

purpose: Display authorized worker/job state through a streaming channel.
notes: Build authenticated SSE/WebSocket telemetry with backpressure and redaction. Mining-specific automation is separately gated below.

purpose: Concept for routing financial operations and monitoring balances.
notes: No profit/yield is demonstrated. Any finance integration needs explicit scope, read-only defaults, real quotes, risk disclosure and human authorization for transactions.

purpose: Automated faucet/link discovery and payout collection concept.
notes: Not built as claim automation or anti-bot evasion. Safe alternative: a reviewed directory of legitimate reward programs and manual, terms-compliant tracking.

purpose: Mining-worker management and telemetry concept.
notes: No silent mining or use of third-party/cloud credits without authorization. Any later authorized lab requires cost caps, explicit opt-in and clear stop controls.

purpose: Network reachability, proxy diagnostics and fallback routing.
notes: Implement observable health checks and normal retry/backoff. IP rotation to evade bans, rate limits or access controls is excluded.

purpose: Original text describes platform enforcement/detection monitoring.
notes: Replace evasion with platform-policy compliance metrics, account health alerts, appeal guidance and conservative rate limits.

purpose: Source describes solving or bypassing third-party access challenges.
notes: No CAPTCHA bypass or anti-bot circumvention. Support accessible, authorized UI testing and official API routes instead.

purpose: Visual UI inspection and layout/control recognition.
notes: Can help inspect owned/authorized interfaces, visual regressions and accessibility. No CAPTCHA solving, stealth clicking or protected-flow automation.

purpose: Identity/persona configuration and email-validation ideas.
notes: Use service-account references and role profiles; do not generate fake platform personas, intercept third-party OTPs or evade account verification.

purpose: Compare variants and learn from controlled task outcomes.
notes: Use ethical experiments, approved test accounts/data and transparent metrics. Do not mutate fingerprints to defeat platform detection.

purpose: Manage controlled version changes to role templates and agent strategies.
notes: Version, diff, test and review every strategy update; no unreviewed self-modification or deployment into production.
